final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT actor_id AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), s2 AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS d FROM film_actor), s3 AS (SELECT s1.a AS a, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.d AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.d IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM s3) SELECT s3.a, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.m AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
